description: Aggregate every display layer within a bounding box — the region counterpart of inspect_point. One call returns counts across the whole area: tenements (live/pending/dead), mines (MINEDEX), known deposits, open-file drillholes, company drillhole & surface geochem + GSWA geochem (count + max Au), WAMEX reports, past activity, and land-access constraints (conservation / native title / pastoral). Use export_data with the same bbox to pull the actual rows of any layer.

metal.description: Optional; filters known deposits to this commodity (Au, Cu, Ni, W, Sn, Co, Ta, Mn, REE)

name: inspect_region
title: Inspect a region
